# QudSystem

> QudSystem (also written QUD System, QUD or Code System) is a software, AI and cybersecurity project ecosystem.

## Canonical sources
- [Official website]({{SITE_URL}}/): Expertise, project areas and approach.
- [Privacy]({{SITE_URL}}/privacy.html): Website data-handling information.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/hussamgalal999/QudSystem-software-company): Website source and documentation.

## Scope and factual limits
Focus areas are software engineering, applied AI and cybersecurity. Selected project areas include CVPEN, Qud School, Qudemy, QudSoft, Qud Project and Vision Guard Systems. Maturity and availability vary. A project mention is not evidence of production readiness, certification, customers or commercial availability.
